source: due2-native: a constraint that reads the witness, written on a permission
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. The baseline binding of odrl:payAmount reads a parameter of the witness (due2-profiles.md §3, §9 #6), as OVAL duty1-3 and the W3C CG C1-C2 use it. A policy that means the requested amount binds its own operand to the request source, which takes precedence over the baseline. Contrast oval-duty-payment, where the same constraint sits on a duty and is admitted.

expected_rejection.why: ex:paid reads odrl:payAmount, bound to due2:witnessSource, but sits on the permission ex:stream, not on a duty. Only a duty has a witness (workflows §5.2, §5.3), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
